name: Långesjön - Rydöbruk
description: Långesjön to Rydöbruk. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official page/API says 19 km/19000 m; official GPX desc/computed is 18.9/18.904 km; Hylte/Woods/Naturkartan commonly list 18 km/18.0 km; API line.geometry and OSM legacy Långesjön-Sandsjön linework are about 21-22 km.

Official GPX/API geo_json starts at 57.036766,13.011889 and ends at Rydöbruk 56.957437,13.142738. API line.geometry and OSM preserve older Sandsjön endpoint about 2196 m beyond the current GPX endpoint; Naturkartan has current Rydöbruk endpoint but shortened/stale Långesjön start and slug.
Current official name is Långesjön - Rydöbruk, while Långesjön - Sandsjön or Sandsjön - Långesjön persists in secondary/legacy sources.
Swedish page has fuller sights/service text and RV26/accommodation context; English page and Naturkartan mirrors are shorter or differ.
Sandsjön shelter appears in M5 source context but lies about 2.2 km beyond the current M5 GPX endpoint and belongs operationally to M6/next-section/off-section context.
Hallandsleden section prose says shelters have room for 4-6 adults, while facility-style sources commonly say 4-5 people.
